mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC bottomed at -76.4 in t-1w and rebounded 0.8 points to -75.6 in t-0w while RESIDENTIAL stopped climbing, easing from 26.4 to 26.0. Exhaustion of the stay-at-home push means the marginal household is re-entering discretionary retail, so mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds the mean of the last 28 days.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC rose 0.8 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: The next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is below its last-28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL stays flat or declines week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES posted its first gain of the window, rising 1.3 points from -69.9 at t-1w to -68.6 at t-0w. A crossing above a -69.0 weekly reading confirms office commuting is resuming, and returning commuters generate weekday retail and food-service footfall, lifting RETAIL_REC over the following four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved 1.3 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: Weeks with WORKPLACES above -69.0 are followed by a next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean that is not above the prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT kept falling to -70.6 at t-0w even as RETAIL_REC and PARKS turned up, indicating retail trips are becoming short-range and walk-based. Because the discretionary retail catchment depends on transit-fed footfall, continued TRANSIT erosion below -71.0 caps and then reverses the current retail uptick.

failure_condition: In weeks where TRANSIT prints below -71.0, the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC exceeds the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL has held above +25 for three consecutive weeks, marking full stay-at-home saturation, while PARKS recovered 1.1 points to -68.3. Households substituting outdoor activity for indoor leisure also reallocate trips toward retail-adjacent errands, so the interaction lifts RETAIL_REC within one week.

fact:PARKS rose 1.1 points from t-1w to t-0w

mechanism_narrative: PARKS rose 1.1 points to -68.3 and GROCERY_PHARM ticked up 0.4 points to -49.3 at t-0w, the first joint improvement in the window. Joint outdoor-and-essential mobility gains historically precede broader discretionary reopening, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Policy is the binding constraint: with TRANSIT at -70.6 and WORKPLACES at -68.6, the metropolitan area still sits inside an actively tightening restriction regime, and any further tightening of gathering limits and business hours directly truncates retail opening. RETAIL_REC therefore declines over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: Under a tightening regime where TRANSIT breaks below -71.0, the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean is at or above the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-May marks the spring-to-summer transition in Hong Kong: PARKS at -68.3 has already improved 1.1 points off its trough, and lengthening daylight plus warmer weather raise outdoor leisure and street-level retail traffic. The seasonal tailwind lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks regardless of restriction status.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved 1.1 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines over the next 28 days even while PARKS weekly means continue to improve across the four weeks.

As grocery hoarding unwinds, household mobility budgets rotate back to discretionary retail, so the interaction of rising GROCERY_PHARM and falling RESIDENTIAL lifts RETAIL_REC.
